This is the one I use on my RaspberryPi that runs my fileserver, torrents, etc. I like to know its temperature, so that's why that's added and I'm always sshing to and from all my machines so I tend to need the username/hostinfo. I pieced this together by goofing around with it and reading wiki pages. The rest of my machines just don't have the temp bit, so are boring.

58.5'C whatever@superpi: ~/Downloads $

rpitemp()
{
 rpitempfull="$(/opt/vc/bin/vcgencmd measure_temp)"
 rpitemp=${rpitempfull:5}
 echo $rpitemp
}


if [[ ${EUID} == 0 ]] ; then
 export PS1='\e[1;33m\]$(rpitemp) \e[1;31m\]\u@\h: \[\e[1;33m\]\w \$\e[0m\n'
else
 export PS1='\e[1;33m\]$(rpitemp) \e[35m\]\u@\h: \[\e[1;33m\]\w \$\e[0m\n'
fi
